system.description: The target becomes a werewarg: Strength +4 (maximum +6), Dexterity +4 (maximum +6), Constitution +6 (maximum +8), Psyche −2, and Intelligence −4 (minimum −6). It gains Protection 2, night vision, Bite (1d10, Open Roll 8, one action), Claws (1d10, Open Roll 9, two actions), +2 in Brawling, +6 in Body Control, and +6 in Hunting Experience. It loses its usual abilities and capacity for reason, acting on a predatory instinct. Its bites can transmit the disease; an infected victim has a 1-in-20 chance of never returning to its original form after its first transformation.
system.summary: Increases Strength, Dexterity, Constitution and Protection, reduces Psyche and Intelligence, and grants bite, claws and night vision.
